One.|[[Antoc Merrick]] in ''[[The Rebel Files]]''|''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''}} The '''UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft''', also designated as the '''UT-60D U-wing Troop Transport''', was a [[starship]] model manufactured by [[Incom Corporation]] and used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. U-wings served as [[transport]]s, [[gunship]]s, and [[starfighter]]s that dropped [[soldier]]s into battle and provided cover fire. Each vessel had powerful [[KX7 laser cannon|fixed cannons]] that served well in [[Realspace|space]] and versatile gun ports by the loading doors. U-wings were pivotal in transporting and protecting the Rebel Alliance's [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces|ground forces]] during the [[Battle of Scarif]]. ==Characteristics== [[File:UwingFighterConfig-ROOCE.png|thumb|left|250px|A U-wing in fighter configuration]] U-wings were manufactured by [[Incom Corporation]]. Their two wing-like strike foils, or [[S-foils]], were retractable, and could be repositioned forward or aft depending on flight needs.{{StarWarsShow|JGCR89WQ87g|Exclusive Chat with Alden Ehrenreich and Details on Rogue One's Space Monkey|sw_url=video/the-star-wars-show-episode-11}} The movement of these strike foils was controlled by an S-foil articulation servomotor assembly, similar to those installed on the T-65 X-Wing. Although not adept at dogfighting, the U-wing nevertheless found itself in combat situations when providing close air support for both ground and air/space forces.''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' The aft-facing, or combat-flight configuration, increases the coverage envelope of the [[Starship|ship's]] [[deflector shield]]s and radiates the excess heat from the [[Reactor|engine's core]]. The increased wingspan, however, often became a liability in rough atmospheric conditions, resulting in the flight configuration primarily being reserved for high-altitude and [[Realspace|interstellar]] operations. U-wings were armed with a pair of fixed-position [[Taim & Bak]] [[KX7 laser cannon|KX7]] [[laser cannon]]s, which were powerful enough to penetrate the shielding and hull armor of an [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]]. Since its primary weapons required the use of the ship's orientation for targeting, one or both of the loading doors were transformed into gun ports with the mounting of improvised weapons. Therefore, any infantry-based heavy weapon could be mounted to become part of the craft's load-out. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] opted to not equip permanent side-firing modifications so as to not lose this versatility. One such example of these heavy weapons was the [["Roba" M-45 repeating ion blaster]]. [[File:U-Wing_Cockpit.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Cockpit interior of a U-wing]] Atmospheric speeds of up to 950 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]] were made possible by four [[4J.7 fusial thrust engine|4j.7 fusial thrust engines]], rebuilds of Incom's [[9XR]] standby,[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]] attached next to the fuselage. [[Hyperspace]] was achieved by four Incom [[GBk-585 hyperdrive motivator]]s with one mounted in each [[engine]] housing. Travel through hyperspace was often limited due to [[fuel]] requirements as crew [[life support]] requirements would greatly increase the fuel demands beyond efficiency. The two-seater [[cockpit]] was located in the center of the fuselage with [[viewport]]s above and below. U-wings were unusual in the fact that they were equipped with tandem controls. This allowed the craft to be operated by a single [[pilot]] or by a flight team of two. The standardized controls featured across many Incom Corporation designs were present on U-wings. The two fixed-position laser cannons were primarily used for targeting fortifications or enemy starfighters, thus limiting its ground support role. Improvised gun mounts were commonly used to transform one or both of the side doors with heavy weapons. These guns were essential to contested landing sites and extractions. Any infantry heavy weapon, in theory, could become part of the U-Wing's arsenal. The U-wing's shielding, [[armor]], and hold full of passengers led the craft to handle more like a heavy [[repulsorcraft]] than a swift space superiority vessel. In addition, its wide turning radius and subpar acceleration meant it would not function well in a starfighter combat role. [[File:SWR_Old_U-wing_on_Yavin_4.png|thumb|left|200px|An older model U-wing landing at Massassi Base]] The older model{{Rebels|Kindred}} U-wings lacked S-foils, and had two engines instead of the four that the newer models would go on to possess.{{Rebels|The Occupation}} A civilian version existed in the [[BT-45D U-wing]] but was of no use in combat situations as it was stripped of all its military offensive and defensive applications, as well as its [[hyperdrive]]. The U-wing could also be modified with electronic warfare equipment, allowing it to broadcast a power jamming signal across ten thousand frequencies. While an opponent would be aware of the jamming, they would be incapable of deducing who or what was causing it except through visual identification. The drawback to this jamming was that it also affected friendly starfighters flying nearby, preventing datalinks or communication signals between them until the jamming turned off.[[Alphabet Squadron (novel)|''Alphabet Squadron'']] ==History== ===Acquisition by the Rebellion=== The UT-60D{{StarWarsShow|p8ExkYS_Uog|"Weird Al" Yankovic Interview, New Rogue One Vehicle Revealed, and More|sw_url=video/the-star-wars-show-episode-13}} was one of the last ships to be produced by Incom Corporation before it was [[Imperialization|nationalized]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]. Due to this, the U-wing never enjoyed a full production run. A "lost" shipment of U-wings ended up in the hands of the Rebel Alliance after the careful manipulation of [[Imperial Senate|Senate]] records by [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]]. The rarity of the craft made them all the more valuable to the Rebel cause. Following the diversion of the shipment, Senator Organa was interviewed by [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Chief Investigator]] [[Axvering]]. [[File:U-wing-SW_Battlefront.png|thumb|right|270px|The U-wing was added to the ranks of the Rebel Alliance Navy.]] By the time the Rebel Alliance adopted [[Great Temple|Base One]] as their military HQ around [[2 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' the U-wing was under investigation for full inclusion into [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Command]] and [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces]]. General [[Antoc Merrick]] along with [[Colonel]] [[Bandwin Cor]] and U-wing pilots wrote the recommendation. In [[1 BBY]], [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] had a U-wing starfighter,{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Type of Ship in Rebels|video=iasSt3JSV4Q|nolive=1}} painted [[Color|black]] in their specific markings. Saw and [[Edrio]] "Two Tubes" took it to [[Mission to Jalindi|destroy]] a [[Jalindi Station|relay station]] on [[Jalindi]], and ended up rescuing [[Sabine Wren|members]] [[C1-10P|of]] [[Ezra Bridger|the]] [[Spectres]] after their own mission went awry. They later [[Mission to Faos Station|went]] to [[Faos Station]] to infiltrate [[Freighter 2716]]. Edrio trailed after the [[freighter]] and recovered Gerrera before the freighter's [[kyber crystal]] cargo exploded. At the same [[time]], the [[Lothal resistance group]] under [[Ryder Azadi]] had possession of an older model U-wing, which had two fewer engines than its newer counterpart, and did not have a working hyperdrive. When the Spectres [[Theft of the TIE Defender Elite|returned]] to [[Lothal]], Azadi [[transport]]ed them to discover information on the [[TIE/D Defender Elite]].{{Rebels|Flight of the Defender}} Later, [[Hera Syndulla]] used Azadi's U-wing, now equipped with a functional hyperdrive salvaged from the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] Elite, to escape Lothal and give the TIE Defender Elite [[flight data recorder]] to [[Alliance High Command]]. Based on the information, the Alliance decided to [[Attack on Lothal|attack]] the [[Imperial Armory Complex]] which was producing the TIE Defenders.{{Rebels|Crawler Commandeers}} Early in the rebellion, their U-wings were deployed in several roles, including as troop transport, gunship, and medevac lifter. Several of the ships also acted as cargo transports between the [[Telaris system]] and other locations. A group of agents working with a [[Fulcrum]] used a U-wing as their operational vehicle. They were captured at [[Scarif]] but managed to escape."[[Unwelcome Arrival]]" One of the most popular U-wing pilots on Yavin-4 was [[Heff Tobber]]. [[File:Bodhi_Rook_U-Wing_XWM.png|thumb|left|250px|A U-wing landing at Massassi outpost]] In late 1 BBY, the U-wing ''[[Bravo One]]'' took part in the [[Liberation of Erso|extraction]] of [[Jyn Erso]] from a [[Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817|labor camp]] on the [[planet]] of [[Wobani]]. ''Bravo One'', piloted by the former Imperial [[KX-series security droid|security droid]] [[K-2SO]], experienced technical difficulties and was unable to jump to hyperspace after the successful liberation of Erso by [[Extraction Team Bravo]]. The U-wing then sought refuge in an [[Asteroid field|asteroid belt]] in the [[Wobani system]] to conduct repairs and request assistance from the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]]. The [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] [[squadron]] [[Red Flight (Rebel Alliance)|Red Flight]] came to ''Bravo One''{{'s}} assistance and attempted to escort it to the [[CR90 corvette]] [[Vigilant (CR90 corvette)|''Vigilant'']]. The rendezvous was interrupted by the arrival of an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] and the destruction of the ''Vigilant''. ''Bravo One'' was then caught in the [[Star Destroyer]]'s [[tractor beam]] and subsequently freed by Red Flight's assault on the Imperial starship. With repairs complete, ''Bravo One'' and Red Flight leapt to hyperspace to rejoin the Alliance Fleet. ''Bravo One'' returned to [[Great Temple|Base One]] on [[Yavin 4]] to deliver Erso to [[Mon Mothma]] and [[General]] [[Davits Draven]].''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]'': Rogue One: X-wing VR Mission'' Shortly after, Jyn, [[Captain]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], and K-2SO set off from Yavin 4 aboard the U-wing ''[[LMTR-20]]'' bound for the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]. After a [[Battle on Jedha|fight]] with Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s and capture by Gerrera's Partisans, the U-wing—piloted by K-2SO—extracted Erso and Andor as well as the pilot [[Bodhi Rook]] and former [[Guardians of the Whills]] [[Baze Malbus]] and [[Chirrut Îmwe]] from Gerrera's [[Catacombs of Cadera|hidden base]]. Simultaneously, the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] conducted a [[Destruction of Jedha City|test firing]] of the [[battle station]]'s [[superlaser]] against [[Jedha City]], creating a wall of rubble that the U-wing was forced to outrun. The U-wing was able to leap to hyperspace from [[atmosphere]] after near destruction by falling debris. The group then headed aboard the U-wing to [[Eadu]] in an attempt to rescue—or, in Andor's case, kill—the Imperial [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]]. The U-wing quickly encountered huge rock pillars and heavy rain on its approach to the [[Eadu Flight Station|Flight Station]] where Galen was stationed. The U-wing's course remained steady until one of the right engines hit a rock pillar, resulting in the ship's plummet to the planet's surface. The U-wing was eventually abandoned as Andor, then the rest of the passengers, left the damaged craft to continue their [[Mission to Eadu|mission]]. ===Galactic Civil War=== [[File:U_wing_fires_at_ATACT.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A U-wing's door gunner fires at an AT-ACT.]] The U-wings of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]] as well as the rest of Base One's [[starfighter]]s were scrambled soon after the Rebel Alliance learned of the "[[Rogue One]]" [[squad]]'s [[Battle of Scarif|infiltration]] of the [[Citadel Tower]] on Scarif. Blue Squadron emerged from hyperspace along with the Alliance [[Fleet]] led by [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] and headed toward the [[Shield Gate]]. At least one U-wing made it through with an escort of [[X-wing starfighter|X-wings]] past the [[Planetary shield|shield]]. A [[Bistan's U-wing|U-wing]] piloted by [[Laren Joma]] and [[Taslet Colb]] provided air cover for [[Alliance Military|Rebel forces]] already on the ground. The U-wing's door [[gunner]], [[Bistan]], unleashed a volley of [[Ion blaster|ion]] fire upon [[All Terrain Armored Cargo Transport|AT-ACTs]], disabling them. The U-wing then descended to the surface delivering ground reinforcements to the battered Rebel units. Eventually, the Imperial air defenses proved too much and the U-wing was shot down resulting in the [[death]] of all who remained aboard, along with a number of stormtroopers who were caught in the crash zone. The Rebel's overall mission was a success as the Death Star's [[Death Star plans|plans]] were captured by the Rebellion. During the [[Battle of Yavin]], one was present in the [[hangar]] of Base One, one of the few ships still available after the heavy losses at Scarif.{{StoryCite|story=Grounded|book=From a Certain Point of View}} One U-wing delivered the captured [[Inferno Squad]] member [[Iden Versio]] to the security cruiser ''[[Invincible Faith]]'', although it was a ruse to delete critical intel. The gunships also saw action during the pivotal [[Battle of Endor]]. They were deployed to the moon of [[Endor]] to secure Imperial assets right after the destruction of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]]. Shortly afterward, three of them attempted to [[Attack on Fondor|board]] the [[Dauntless (Imperial I-class)|''Dauntless'']] at [[Fondor]], although they were shot down by Inferno Squad. At least one U-wing was also used to land reinforcements at Naboo during the ground stages of the [[Battle of Theed|battle]] during [[Operation: Cinder]].''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' After the [[Battle of Endor]], one U-wing was used by a [[battle-racer]]. When General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] joined the race to uncover an informant, they were attacked by an Imperial Star Destroyer. Calrissian formed an impromptu [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]], including the U-wing pilot, to drive off the warship.{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=23|story=A Race for Answers}} [[Vanguard Squadron]] escorted a boarding party aboard three U-wings to [[Battle of Yavin Prime|capture]] the Star Destroyer ''[[Victorum]]''. Vanguard leader [[Kierah Koovah|Gunny]] was also piloting one of the gunships during her time with the unit.''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]'' U-wings also saw action during the [[Battle of Jakku]] as a part of the [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Fleet|Starfleet]] with at least one deploying [[New Republic Special Forces]] during the battle. It was nearly shot down by a homing rocket, but Jom Barell intercepted the missile with his own body by flying out of the ship with a jetpack, saving the U-wing and its occupants at the cost of his own life.''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'' A U-wing diagram was included in the archival book and data vault ''[[The Rebel Files]]'', [[Excavation on Durkteel|uncovered]] and annotated during the [[Cold War]] and passed down to the [[Resistance]]. [[Yrica Quell]] took a [[New Republic Intelligence]] U-wing piloted by [[Kairos]] to the [[Entropian Hive]] during her mission to recruit [[Nath Tensent]]. Kairos continued to fly it as [[Alphabet Squadron]] was formed. During the [[Troithe operation]] weeks later, she flew close air support for [[61st Mobile Infantry|Twilight Company]]. As they advanced to capture the [[governor]], Kairos launched into the thickest part of the fighting, crashing her vessel and requiring medical evacuation.''[[Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]'' Kairos used a new U-wing during the [[Hunt for Shadow Wing]], destroying it in combat during the [[Attack on Coruscant's Verity District]], which occured concurrent to the Galactic Civil War's final conflict at Jakku.''[[Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]'' ===New Republic Era=== During the [[New Republic Era]], a U-wing came in to land at the New Republic's [[Adelphi Base]].{{SWYouTube|IHWlvwu8t1w|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22}} ===First Order-Resistance War=== U-wings were part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that fought in the [[Battle of Exegol]], assisting the [[Resistance]] in their fight against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]].{{Film|IX}} ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Rogue_One_Concept_Art_Celebration.png|thumb|left|250px|Concept art]] The U-wing was created and developed for the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Anthology Series|film]] ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. Concept art for the ship was first revealed at the ''Rogue One'' panel at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]].{{SW|url=news/rogue-one-details-revealed-at-star-wars-celebration-anaheim|text=''Rogue One'' Details Revealed at ''Star Wars'' Celebration Anaheim}} The U-wing was detailed on [[May 17]], 2016, in a preview of the [[2017]] reference book ''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story: The Official Visual Story Guide''.{{LegacyEdelweiss|url=#sku=1942556411&page=1|text=Rogue One: A Star Wars Story: The Official Visual Story Guide}} Its formal designation was revealed on ''[[The Star Wars Show]]'' on [[August 3]], 2016. As the protagonists' ship, the craft went through hundreds of design iterations. It was originally intended to be a helicopter-sized craft attached to the heroes' main ship, but they moved away from the larger ship and focused on the smaller craft.''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' According to the [[Canon|non-canon]] tv series ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'', the repairs done to Lieutenant [[Colvett Valeria]]'s U-wing by [[Freemaker Salvage and Repair]] by finding a [[type A vector coil]] is what led them to be hired by the Rebel Alliance.{{FreemakerAdventures|Home One (episode)}} ==Appearances== {{ScrollBox| *''[[Star Wars: Force Arena]]''
